query:
UPDATE watch_patterns SET
            callback_url = $3,
            patterns = $4,
            media_want = $5,
            match_targets = $6,
            match_mode = $7,
            min_score = $8,
            media_type_id = $9,
            auto_download = $10,
            metadata = $11,
            enabled = $12,
            upgrade_allowed = $13,
            search_not_before = $14,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE source_system = $1 AND source_id = $2
